allowed_ips.title: Allowed IPs
allowed_ips.hint: Trusted IPv4/IPv6 addresses and networks. These entries win over exact bans, blocked networks, and default-deny mode. IPv4/IPv6 wildcards like 192.168.1.* or 2001:db8:1:2:* are supported.
allowed_ips.remove_confirm: Remove this Allowed IP? With default-deny or blocked networks active, removing a trusted entry can lock out access.

allowed_regions.title: Public Region Lock
allowed_regions.hint: Restrict public access to one detected or custom GeoIP region.
allowed_regions.warning: High impact: when a region is selected, public IPs outside it are blocked before login. Allowed IPs, Home Assistant internal traffic, and the Protect integration callbacks option are respected.
allowed_regions.detected: Detected from this Home Assistant server: {location}
allowed_regions.unavailable: Local country and province/state choices will appear after the GeoIP database is ready on this Home Assistant server.
allowed_regions.anywhere_hint: Do not limit public access by GeoIP location.
allowed_regions.local_country_hint: Only public IPs from this country can connect.
allowed_regions.local_subdivision_hint: Only public IPs from this province/state can connect.
allowed_regions.custom_hint: Use ISO codes only when you need a different country or province/state.

blocked_ips.title: Blocked IPs
blocked_ips.hint: Home Assistant's native exact IPv4/IPv6 block list, written oldest first in ip_bans.yaml.

blocked_networks.title: Blocked Networks
blocked_networks.hint: Managed IPv4/IPv6 CIDR or wildcard networks, enforced without writing ranges into ip_bans.yaml.

settings.ban_notifications_enabled_hint: Show alerts when IPs are blocked.
settings.callback_route_protection_enabled_hint: Let Home Assistant webhook callbacks pass managed blocking rules.
settings.geoip_enabled_hint: Show approximate public-IP locations when the local database is installed.
settings.allowed_region_hint: Optional public-IP blocking rule. Allowed IPs and Home Assistant internal traffic always win.
settings.local_region_unavailable: Local country or province/state will appear here after GeoIP is enabled and the database is ready.
settings.allowlisted_logins_can_ban_hint: Be careful: trusted IPs can be blocked.
settings.default_deny_enabled_hint: Be careful: only Allowed IPs can connect.

backup.restore_confirm: Restore from the on-disk backup and replace current IP Ban Manager settings and exact IP bans?
backup.transfer_hint: Download a copy to this device, or upload a backup to restore.
backup.upload_confirm: Upload {filename} and replace current IP Ban Manager settings and exact IP bans?
